works.title: Collected Poems of Bai Juyi
authors: Yuan Zhen 元稹 assisted an early collection
works.description: New position 46 in the owner-supplied audited Chinese-language revision. Public address, extended narrative and apparently accessible diction are major poetic accomplishments, not evidence of simplicity. Adding Bai Juyi corrects a conspicuous omission from the classical poetry field and makes room for a different kind of poetic ambition.

works.title: Collected Poems of Li Shangyin
works.description: New position 47 in the owner-supplied audited Chinese-language revision. Dense allusion and uncertain situations make the relation between verbal beauty and knowledge unusually difficult. The addition recognizes a central alternative to the transparency often associated with lyric poetry. Obscurity is assessed as an artistic resource, not automatic profundity.

works.title: The Drunkard
works.description: New position 53 in the owner-supplied audited Chinese-language revision. The unstable narration connects artistic aspiration, exhaustion and commercial writing. Adding it gives Hong Kong modernism an independent place in the list, supported by its formal experimentation rather than by treating the city as an appendage of mainland literary history.

authors: Wang Wen-hsing / Wang Wenxing 王文興
works.description: New position 57 in the owner-supplied audited Chinese-language revision. The family is made strange through fractured arrangement and painstaking verbal invention. Its addition corrects an absence particularly visible when Taiwan's modernist writing is considered alongside the mainland family novels already prominent in the baseline.

works.title: Dream Recollections of Tao'an
works.description: New position 62 in the owner-supplied audited Chinese-language revision. Objects, performances, foods and vanished pleasures acquire force through finely measured recollection. The addition strengthens literary nonfiction with a work whose episodic form is inseparable from historical loss. Its composition and eventual publication are distinguished.

authors: Wu He / Wuhe 舞鶴 / Chen Guocheng 陳國城
